title: Source lock
description: sources/<short>/source.lock.json: the source record of every file a refresh procedure brought into this repository (spec 004 FR-005).

procedure.description: The id of the procedure that owns this folder, for example refresh-dedl.

local.description: Present only for runs against a local checkout (--source). refresh:verify rejects any lock carrying it.

sourceHeads.description: Head of develop in each source repository at fetch time.

releases.description: Latest published release per source repository at fetch time (research R10). Absent for procedures that do not use releases; a repository with no release maps to null.

config.description: SHA-256 (of the text with LF line endings) of each procedures/config/ file the run applied, so a merged mapping change alone starts a refresh. Absent for procedures that read no mapping.

inputs.description: Source files a procedure reads but does not copy (for example a screenshot readme). Resolve compares their blobs like those of files.

derived.description: Files the procedure generates from its sources and mappings (catalogue.json, screenshots.json, hosts.json). They have no source record of their own; refresh:verify checks their SHA-256 so a hand edit is caught.

commit.description: Latest commit on develop that touched sourcePath.

gitBlob.description: Git blob SHA of sourcePath at commit; compared by Resolve to detect change without downloading.

licence.description: SPDX identifier from the source repository, or "unstated".
